conjecture: Given a collection of at least (2/3)*C(n,3) distinct triples from the set {1,2,...,n}, there must exist four distinct elements a,b,c,d such that all four triples abc, abd, acd, and bcd are all in the collection (i.e., the collection contains a complete 3-uniform hypergraph K_4^3 as a subhypergraph).
